Shepard High School]] in [[Palos Heights, Illinois]]. Hall, a four-year starter at [[George Washington University]] from 2002 through 2006 was a tri-captain his senior season on a team that went 27–3. Those Colonial teams won the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]] in 2005 and made the NCAA tournament in [[2005 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament#Bracket|2005]] and [[2006 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|2006]]. Hall was inducted into George Washington's Athletics Hall of Fame in 2019.[https://gwsports.com/news/2019/8/8/general-gw-announces-hall-of-fame-class-of-2019.aspx GW Hall of Fame], accessed January 24, 2021. ==Professional career== [[Undrafted]] after his senior season, Hall joined the [[Tulsa 66ers]] of the [[NBA Development League]]. On February 28, 2007, the [[Washington Wizards]] signed him to a ten-day contract due to injuries of forwards [[Antawn Jamison]] and [[Caron Butler]].[https://web.archive.org/web/20070328165650/http://www.nba.com/wizards/news/hall_070321.html WIZARDS: Wizards Sign Mike Hall for Remainder of the Season] He was signed to a second ten-day contract shortly afterwards, and on March 21, the team signed him for the rest of the season. He appeared in two games for the Wizards and was released in late October, 2007 due to salary cap reasons.[http://blog.washingtonpost.com/wizardsinsider/2007/10/hall_released_pesh_out_for_ton.html Hall released, Pesh out for tonight's game – Wizards Insider] On August 11, 2008, Hall signed with [[Olimpia Milano|Armani Jeans Milano]] of the [[Lega Basket Serie A]], the top level of Italian basketball.{{cite news |title=Armani Jeans tabs forward Mike Hall |url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/34390/180/armani-jeans-tabs-forward-mike-hall |accessdate=November 26, 2014 |work=Euroleague.net |date=August 10, 2008}} In the 2008–09 season, Hall was one of the top rebounders of [[Serie A (basketball) 2008-09|Serie A]]. Thanks also to his good performances, Armani Jeans reached [[Euroleague 2008-09]] Top 16 and Serie A finals, which they eventually lost to [[Mens Sana Basket|Montepaschi Siena]]. In the 2008–09. he scored career highs 27 points and 9 rebounds in Euroleague, and 23 points and 15 rebounds in Serie A. In August 2010, Hall signed a contract with [[Teramo Basket|Bancatercas Teramo]],{{cite news |title=Teramo signs Mike Hall |url=http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/83928/teramo-signs-mike-hall.html |accessdate=November 26, 2014 |work=Sportando.com |date=August 6, 2010}} but was released in December 2010 after the team's 0–5 start. On December 16, 2010, he was acquired by the [[Dakota Wizards]] of the NBA Development League.[https://web.archive.org/web/20110219042638/http://nba.fanhouse.com/2010/12/16/mike-hall-former-washington-wizard-acquired-by-dakota-of-nba-d/ NBA D-League's Dakota Wizards Acquire Mike Hall] FanHouse, December 16, 2010 In January 2011, he moved to Turkey and signed with [[Erdemir SK]].{{cite news |title=UPDATE: Mike Hall accepts the proposal from Erdemir |url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/85212/update-mike-hall-accepts-the-proposal-from-erdemir.html |accessdate=November 26, 2014 |work=Sportando.com |date=January 27, 2011}}{{cite news |title=Hall İmzaladı |url=https://mixbasket.blogspot.com/2011/01/hall-imzalad.html |accessdate=November 26, 2014 |work=mixbasket.blogspot.com |language=Turkish |date=January 29, 2011}} At the end of the season, he left Erdemir.{{cite news |title=Hall, Thomas and Barbour will leave Erdemir |url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/86362/hall-thomas-and-barbour-will-leave-erdemir.html |accessdate=November 26, 2014 |work=Sportando.com |date=June 7, 2011}} In January 2012, he signed with [[Baloncesto Fuenlabrada|Fuenlabrada]] of Spain for the rest of the season.{{cite news On November 29, 2012, he signed with [[Maccabi Ashdod B.C.|Maccabi Ashdod]] of Israel.{{cite news |title=Maccabi Ashdod signs Mardy Collins, Mike Hall |url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/israel/96983/maccabi-ashdod-signs-mardy-collins-mike-hall.html |accessdate=November 26, 2014 |work=Sportando.com |date=November 29, 2012}} In his second game with Maccabi, he got injured and missed the rest of the season.{{cite news |title=Maccabi Ashdod, Mike Hall is done for the season |url=http://www.sportando.com/en/world/america/115065/toros-de-aragua-sign-mike-hall.html |accessdate=November 26, 2014 |work=Sportando.com |date=March 26, 2014}} In September 2014, Hall signed with ways with Manresa, after playing only two games.{{cite news |title=Mike Hall termina su contrato con La Bruixa d'Or Manresa |url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=107779 |accessdate=November 26, 2014 |work=acb.com |language=Spanish |date=October 15, 2014}}{{cite news |title=Basquet Manresa parts ways with Mike Hall |url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/137856/basquet-manresa-parts-ways-with-mike-hall.html |accessdate=November 26, 2014 |work=Sportando.com |date=October 16, 2014}} On November 26, 2014, he signed with [[Juventud Sionista]] of Argentina.{{cite news |title=Mike Hall (ex La Bruixa d'Or) signs at Sionista |url=http://www.latinbasket.com/Argentina/news/384596/Mike-Hall-%28ex-La-Bruixa-d%27Or%29-signs-at-Sionista |accessdate=November 26, 2014 |work=Eurobasket.com |date=November 26, 2014}} He left Sionista after only three games. On February 24, 2015, he signed with [[Aries Trikala B.C.|Aries Trikala]] of the [[Greek Basket League]].{{cite news |title=Mike Hall and Quintin Kwame Alexander sign with Trikala |url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/greece/153482/mike-hall-and-quintin-kwame-alexander-sign-with-trikala.html |accessdate=February 24, 2015 |work=Sportando.com |date=February 24, 2015}} On April 17, 2015, he left Trikala and signed with [[Scaligera Basket Verona|Scaligera Verona]] of the Italian [[Serie A2 Basket]] for the rest of the season.{{cite news |title=Tezenis Verona announces Mike Hall |url=http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/a2-gold/158649/tezenis-verona-announces-mike-hall.html |accessdate=April 17, 2015 |work=Sportando.com |date=April 17, 2015}} On October 28, 2015, Hall signed with [[Pallacanestro Biella]] of the Italian Serie A2 Basket.{{cite news |title=Angelico Biella announces Mike Hall, parts ways with Marcel Jones |url=http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a2-ovest/180201/angelico-biella-announces-mike-hall-parts-ways-with-marcel-jones.html |accessdate=October 30, 2015 |work=Sportando.com |date=October 28, 2015}} He later played for {{interlanguage link|Pallacanestro Piacenza|it}}, [[Kleb Basket Ferrara]] and again Pallacanestro Biella. On October 20, 2021, Hall announced his retirement from professional basketball.{{Cite news|title=European basketball journeyman Mike Hall announces retirement as a player|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/european-basketball-journeyman-mike-hall-announces-retirement-as-a-player/?dev|access-date=November 22, 2021|website=Sportando|date=20 October 2021
